description: R.A. Tillekeratne Bandara and Two Others v. People’s Bank R.A. Tillekeratne Bandara and Two Others v. People’s Bank View More before Hon. Anil Gooneratne, J.
parties: R.A. Tillekeratne Bandara and Two Others v. People’s Bank R.A. Tillekeratne Bandara and Two Others v. People’s Bank View More
keywords: In a debt recovery action under the Debt Recovery (Special Provisions) Act, the Petitioners appealed against the decree nisi being made absolute, alleging they were denied an opportunity to obtain leave to appeal. Held - the Petitioners had admitted liability while simultaneously attempting to contest the action, contrary to the statutory procedure; Application dismissed with the District Court judgment affirmed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Debt Recovery (Special Provisions) Act No. 2 of 1990 (as amended)
